The final sum is `n*(n-1)/2`. The largest single addition is at `i = n-1`, producing `n*(n-1)/2`. For `n=65536`: `65536*65535/2 = 2147450880 ≤ 2147483647` ✓. For `n=65537`: the addition at `i=65536` yields `2147516416 > 2147483647` ✗. The `i++` increment never overflows since `i` reaches at most `n ≤ 65536`.
